what: Back-to-back tilize calls with InitOnly/Neither/UninitOnly and the default UnpackAndPackReconfigure re-run pack_reconfig_data_format after fast_tilize_init on every later call, silently corrupting output (pcc ~0.5 on RM W=4096, K=2). The documented example 6 shows exactly this default usage.
suggest: Have Neither/UninitOnly skip reconfig internally (or static_assert NoReconfigure), and fix example 6 to pass NoReconfigure on the follow-on calls.

what: The skill hardcodes L1_BUDGET=1499136, and get_max_worker_l1_unreserved_size() returns 1530976, but the real CB space on this Blackhole was 1460288 (1572864 - allocator base 112576). Sizing against either overflowed L1 for fp32 W=8192.
suggest: Document ttnn.device.get_memory_view(device, ttnn.BufferType.L1).largest_contiguous_bytes_free_per_bank as the CB budget query (it is also net of L1-resident tensors); drop the hardcoded constant.

what: The AccumulateViaAdd partial fold unpacks the mask as srcB without reconfiguring srcB away from the input CB format, so a bf16 mask (what the design and prepare_reduce_mask docs suggest) is misread when the input CB is Float32. This is undocumented.
suggest: Reconfig srcB to scaler_dfb inside fold_partial_last (and restore it after), or document that the mask CB must match the input CB format.

what: The design aliased cb_sumsq with cb_normed at capacity round_up(r*max(c,n_sq), lcm(c,n_sq)). The reduce reads its r*n_sq window by index, so the window drifts across blocks and eventually straddles fifo_limit. The planner did not account for the rule that indexed windows must not wrap.
suggest: The planner reference should state that any CB read by index (BulkWait/NoWait reduce, Offset/Strided chain) must have capacity equal to an exact multiple of its per-block window, so its pointers return to base every block.
